_: The soldier rig pipeline's numbers (realm/tools/rig/rig_unit.py; docs/TUNING.md). tris: the triangle budget a mesh is decimated to (3-6k reads at army height). weld: metres under which loose vertices are merged before decimating. remesh: voxel size in metres for a remesh first (0 = off; it drops the texture's UVs, so only for a mesh too broken to decimate). man.source: the Mixamo-skeleton character whose skin weights are copied; man.arms: degrees the source's arms are lowered from its T-pose to match the mesh's stance before the copy ('auto' tries each of man.armTries and keeps the one whose width best matches the mesh). man.clips: Mixamo clips baked for the army, [name, looping]. horse.source and horse.clips: the same for a horse. influences: bones per vertex kept after the copy. rigid.auto: whether gear (a weapon, a shield) is found and made rigid on its own; rigid.limb: how far from the lower arm's line (a share of the unit's height) a vertex must stand to count as gear, not flesh; rigid.min: the fewest joined vertices that make a piece of gear; rigid.handBias: over 1 sends more pieces to the hand, under 1 to the forearm; units.<name>.rigid: boxes instead, [bone, [x0,y0,z0], [x1,y1,z1]] in shares of the mesh's bounds. mask.bright, mask.grey: a texture pixel is white cloth when its brightness is over bright and its saturation under grey; mask.erode: pixels the cloth is shrunk by, which drops steel's thin highlights; mask.soften: pixels of blur on the mask's edge. ground: each frame of each clip, the hips raised or lowered so the man's lowest point (gear left out) touches the ground. units: per-mesh overrides by file stem (yaw in degrees to turn a mesh that faces the wrong way, arms, tris; clips, the unit's own baked clips instead of man.clips; roles, which of them plays each part, for data/army.json meshes.<dir>.tracks). Gear found by rigid boxes or auto is cut off the body as its own piece and bound whole to its bone. units.<stem>.mask: a dyed unit's cloth found by hue instead of white (hue [from, to] in 0..1, wrapping when from > to; sat the least saturation; val [least, most] brightness): the Meshy soldiers' blue, crimson and green.
